extracted text: The failed RC ring, dome and cylindrical shell of tank were made of AA 2219 aluminium alloy. The recess cone ring was in T6 temper condition, while the dome, made of 3.2 mm sheets of AA 2219 aluminium alloy was in T87 condition. The paper refers to the alloy as Al-6.3 Cu in the title, which appears to be the average copper content across the various components.
property mapping:
UTS (MPa) = Ultimate Tensile Strength in MPa
0.2% YS (MPa) = 0.2% Yield Strength in MPa
%E = Elongation percentage
abbreviations:
AA = Aluminum Association
T6 = Solution heat treated and artificially aged
T87 = Solution heat treated, cold worked and artificially aged
RC = Recess Cone
HAZ = Heat Affected Zone

- Dome: 6.1% Cu, 0.41% Mn, 0.27% Si, 0.10% Fe, 0.007% Cr, 0.06% Ti, 0.18% Zr, Balance Al
- Recess ring: 6.8% Cu, 0.40% Mn, 0.24% Si, 0.08% Fe, 0.007% Cr, 0.06% Ti, 0.16% Zr, Balance Al
